description: NaSn₂F₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/nbc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are four shorter (2.34 Å) and four longer (2.41 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are four shorter (2.21 Å) and two longer (2.42 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Sn is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four F atoms. There are a spread of Sn-F bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.47 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sn atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sn atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Sn atom.
